description: Convert between behavior3 JSON and BehaviorTree.CPP XML (v4 for ROS 2 Jazzy and Groot2, v3 for ROS 2 Humble), the same way the editor imports and exports. Returns the converted text and any issues (BT.CPP has no equivalent for some behavior3 nodes and vice versa).

to.description: Target format: behavior3, btcpp-v4 or btcpp-v3

tree.description: The tree: behavior3 JSON: {"title": "...", "root": "<id of the first node under the root>", "nodes": {"<id>": {"name": "<node type>", "title": "<optional label>", "children": ["<id>", ...] (composites, in run order) or "child": "<id>" (decorators), "properties": {...}}}, "custom_nodes": [{"name": "IsEnemyVisible", "category": "condition"}]}. Positions ("display") are optional. Any node name that isn't built in (see list_node_types) must be declared in custom_nodes with a category of action, condition, composite or decorator. A whole project ({"trees": [...], "custom_nodes": [...]}) or BehaviorTree.CPP XML also works.

name: convert_tree
title: Convert a behavior tree
